title: KRN adopts itself: .agents/skills is installer output
body:
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-skills-1115l.md slice 4
Why: operator: KRN must run on the same universal skills it installs; today .agents/skills is hand-written.
Outcome: krn adopt --refresh on this repository regenerates .agents/skills from src/adopt/skills (krn-* directories deleted); references in tests, evals/fr40, spec/*.json, evals/skill-selection/prompts.json, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md follow; a test asserts adoptionDrift(repoRoot) is empty for .agents/skills/**.
Files: .agents/skills/, test/rules/project-skills.test.ts, evals/fr40, spec/*.json, evals/skill-selection/prompts.json
Proof: the drift test passes; npm test green; a lead session started here loads delivery-lead.
Predicted: proof stop-refusals <= 0
